stem: Which of the following numbers has an odd number of factors?
explanation: Correct option: (C). 49 = 7 x 7, so its factor 7 is its own partner and the factors are 1, 7 and 49 (three factors). 12 has six factors (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12), 18 has six (1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 18) and 50 has six (1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50); every factor of these has a different partner, so they have an even number of factors.

stem: In the 100-locker puzzle, which of these lockers is toggled exactly 3 times?
explanation: Correct option: (D). A number has exactly 3 factors when it is the square of a prime: 49 = 7 x 7 has factors 1, 7, 49. Locker 27 has 4 factors (1, 3, 9, 27), locker 64 has 7 factors (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64) and locker 81 has 5 factors (1, 3, 9, 27, 81).

stem: Read the case. After all 100 people have had their turn, what happens to lockers 36 and 48?
options: 36 is closed after 8 toggles; 48 is open after 9 toggles
36 is open after 9 toggles; 48 is closed after 10 toggles
Both stay open, because both are toggled by Person 1
Both end closed, because both have many factor pairs
explanation: Correct option: (B). 36 has factors 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 36 (nine, since 6 x 6 pairs with itself), an odd count, so it ends open. 48 has factors 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 48 (ten, all in distinct pairs), an even count, so it ends closed. Being touched by Person 1 does not decide the final state, and having many factor pairs does not matter; only whether the count is odd does.

stem: Which of the following statements about perfect squares is true?
options: A number ending in 6 is always a perfect square.
The square of an odd number is always odd.
A square can end with exactly three zeros.
The square of an even number can be odd.
explanation: Correct option: (B). stem: How many natural numbers lie between 16 squared and 17 squared?
explanation: Correct option: (D). 16 squared = 256 and 17 squared = 289. The numbers strictly between them are 257 to 288, which is 289 - 256 - 1 = 32 numbers (in general, 2n numbers lie between n squared and (n+1) squared). 33 is the difference 289 - 256, which also counts one endpoint; 31 subtracts one too many; 16 is just n.

explanation: Correct option: (A). 15625 is the sum of the first 125 odd numbers, so 126 squared is obtained by adding the 126th odd number, 2 x 126 - 1 = 251. So 126 squared = 15625 + 251 = 15876. Adding 126 adds the number itself, 253 is the 127th odd number, and 262 has no basis in the pattern.

stem: Which of the following statements about cubes is true?
options: A cube of a 2-digit number can have 7 digits.
A perfect cube can end in exactly two zeros.
The cube of an odd number is always odd.
Every cube number has an odd number of factors.
